item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli

This multi-journal collection, guest-edited by Diego Matricano, brings together research on entrepreneurship as a means to address major global challenges. The collection welcomes cross-disciplinary contributions from researchers, practitioners, and policymakers examining how entrepreneurship can shape the future through expected and realized changes and their broader implications.

Appel publié par International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Entrepreneurship and global issues
  • Micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis
  • Impact of entrepreneurship
  • Future implications of entrepreneurship
  • Internationalization and entrepreneurship
  • Entrepreneurship in diverse organizational contexts
  • Global entrepreneurship research
